description: 萌啦数据Ozon-选品数据分析提供 Ozon 类目、商品、关键词、品牌、店铺与大盘趋势等大数据查询能力，帮助跨境卖家完成选品与运营分析。

display.description_en: Menglar OZON Market Intelligence provides big-data query capabilities for Ozon categories, products, keywords, brands, shops, and market trends to help cross-border sellers with product selection and operations analysis.
display.description_zh: 萌啦数据Ozon-选品数据分析提供 Ozon 类目、商品、关键词、品牌、店铺与大盘趋势等大数据查询能力，帮助跨境卖家完成选品与运营分析。
examples_en: List OZON Chinese level-1 categories and analyze the hot-sale performance of a level-3 category in the last 28 days
Show top 15 hot products of a level-3 category in the last 28 days and summarize the price range and sales structure
Compare the differences between CN zone and site-wide hot rankings for a category
Analyze a product's price/rating tracking and traffic keywords in the last 90 days
Query weekly hot keyword rankings for a category and view related products and keyword trends
Compare sales and GMV trends of two shops in the last 28 days and list their hot products
Query a brand's hot-sale ranking in a specified category and its related products
examples_zh: 查询 OZON 中文一级类目，并分析某三级类目近 28 天的热销表现

对比中国专区与全站热销榜在某类目下的差异
分析某商品近 90 天的价格/评分追踪和流量关键词
查某类目热搜词周榜，并看关联商品与关键词趋势
